sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_csm_ctxrul_mgt_rule_matrix</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Disallow QOV on Derived pricing matrix</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var DERIVED_PRICING_MATRIX_TYPE = '3267b2cd93832210320c2af8b28918b3';

    if (current.matrix_type != DERIVED_PRICING_MATRIX_TYPE) {
        return;
    }

    if (!gs.nil(current.query_optimization_variables)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage(gs.getMessage
            ('Query optimization variables are not allowed for Derived pricing matrix.')
        );
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-01-16 21:18:45</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e103bd604fea7210998ff57643ce0b3a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Disallow QOV on Derived pricing matrix</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Context Rule Management" source="sn_csm_ctxrul_mgt">6836e9cc537471105c0eddeeff7b123a</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Context Rule Management">6836e9cc537471105c0eddeeff7b123a</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_e103bd604fea7210998ff57643ce0b3a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-31 20:50:10</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=e103bd604fea7210998ff57643ce0b3a"/></record_update>
